property_summary: For every address A, calling approvedToLog(A) on the correct contract returns true iff approvedLoggers[A] is true OR A is the stored contract owner in the buggy mutant; equivalently, the reference satisfies: for all A, approvedToLog(A) == approvedLoggers[A] (the owner is not implicitly approved), and the mutant violates this by returning true for the owner even when approvedLoggers[owner] is false — so the rule to check is that an address that is not marked in approvedLoggers must return false from approvedToLog (i.e., only addresses with approvedLoggers==true are approved).
change_summary: Insert a check that only the contract owner is considered approved; otherwise return false.
